params.name: direction
params.doc: Exit direction name, such as 'north', 'up' or a custom word.

params.name: to
params.doc: Destination room label.

params.name: entry_index
params.doc: Track index in the destination room where travellers arrive, or -1 for the back.

params.name: tags
params.doc: Tags the rules read, such as 'soundproof' or 'sealed', to price sensing across the exit.

params.name: door
params.doc: Optional door on this exit, built with door(...).

params.name: one_way
params.doc: True if this exit intentionally has no return exit.

settings.name: module
settings.doc: Declares the world's metadata in MODULE.gups.

params.name: engine
params.doc: Engine version the world was written for.

params.name: api_version
params.doc: Script API version the world pins.

params.name: checkpoint_minutes
params.doc: Minutes between routine database checkpoints.

params.name: start_room
params.doc: Room label where new characters start.

params.name: stats
params.doc: The stats actors have, each a name or stat(name, label).

params.name: vitals
params.doc: The vitals actors have, each a name or vital(name, label).

params.name: damage_types
params.doc: The damage types of the world.

params.name: unarmed_damage_type
params.doc: The damage type of an unarmed auto-attack; one of damage_types.

params.name: channels
params.doc: Perception channels beyond sight and sound.

params.name: channel_priority
params.doc: Channels from strongest to weakest: a player is told the text of the first one they perceive. Channels left out follow, built-in ones first.

params.name: prompt
params.doc: The telnet prompt, with {vital} and {max_vital} placeholders.

params.name: plugins
params.doc: Plugin jars in plugins/<id>.jar, each pinned by its 'sha256:<hex>' checksum.

params.name: aliases
params.doc: Alias words for engine commands, such as {"l": "look"}.

params.name: prefixes
params.doc: Single characters that stand for an engine command, such as {"'": "say"}.

params.name: features
params.doc: The engine features the world uses: combat, track, skills, leveling and standing. Fixed per database; changing it needs --wipe.

params.name: rename
params.doc: Renames engine commands, such as {"cast": "invoke"}. Aliases, prefixes and docs use the new names.

params.name: level_mode
params.doc: How earned levels apply: 'auto' (immediately) or 'deferred' (waiting for ctx.level_up). Not fixed per database; changing it needs only a restart.

params.name: standing_history_pulses
params.doc: How long the engine keeps the history of standing changes, in pulses; at least 1. Not fixed per database; changing it needs only a restart.

constants.name: SENSE
constants.doc: Perception senses (SENSE.sight, SENSE.sound, declared senses) and SENSE.all.

hooks.name: on_enter
hooks.doc: Fires after an actor enters the room.

ctx.name: ctx
ctx.doc: The context of one hook invocation.

fields.name: actor
fields.doc: The actor performing the action, or the damage/kill source.

fields.name: affect
fields.doc: The affect, for affect on_tick and on_expire.

fields.name: amount
fields.doc: The total of the vital losses a damage event caused, for on_damage.

fields.name: args
fields.doc: A command's argument text, or a timer's keyword arguments as a dict.

fields.name: channel
fields.doc: For on_perceive: the channel the event travelled on, such as 'sound'.

fields.name: cost
fields.doc: For on_perceive: how much the event weakened on its way here; 0 in the room it happened in.

fields.name: count
fields.doc: How many mobs are being summoned, for before_summon.

fields.name: direction
fields.doc: The movement direction name, for enter and exit hooks.

fields.name: elapsed_pulses
fields.doc: Pulses spent dormant, for on_wake.

fields.name: event
fields.doc: For on_perceive: 'say', 'emote', 'shout', 'combat_start', 'combat', 'death', 'enter', 'exit', 'open', 'close', 'lock', 'unlock' or the event a script passed to ctx.emit. For on_group_change: 'join', 'leave', 'leader' or 'disband'. For on_owner_change: 'set' or 'clear'. For on_disengage: 'flee', 'death' or 'stop'.

fields.name: from_room
fields.doc: The room the actor came from, for enter hooks.

fields.name: group
fields.doc: The group after the change, for on_group_change; None elsewhere.

fields.name: intensity
fields.doc: For on_perceive: the event's strength where it happened.

fields.name: item
fields.doc: The item being picked up, dropped, used or given.

fields.name: label
fields.doc: The prototype label of mobs being summoned, for before_summon.

fields.name: losses
fields.doc: The vital losses behind amount, as vitals(...), for on_damage.

fields.name: new_encumbrance_level
fields.doc: For on_encumbrance_change: the actor's encumbrance level after the change.

fields.name: new_level
fields.doc: For on_level_change: the actor's level after the change.

fields.name: old_encumbrance_level
fields.doc: For on_encumbrance_change: the actor's encumbrance level before the change.

fields.name: old_level
fields.doc: For on_level_change: the actor's level before the change.

fields.name: outcome
fields.doc: How a skill use went, for on_skill_use: 'fail', 'resist', 'success' or 'report'.

fields.name: parts
fields.doc: The damage event's parts, the hit's type first, as struct(type, losses), for on_damage.

fields.name: power
fields.doc: In a skill's resolve, the cast's power; None elsewhere.

fields.name: proposals
fields.doc: For think: behavior proposals, best first.

fields.name: pulse
fields.doc: Game time.

fields.name: reason
fields.doc: Why the affect ended, 'expired' or 'removed', for affect on_expire.

fields.name: rng
fields.doc: The seeded random number generator.

fields.name: room
fields.doc: The room the event happens in.

fields.name: self
fields.doc: The hook's owner.

fields.name: skill
fields.doc: The skill being cast, for before_cast, on_cast_start and on_cast.

fields.name: source_room
fields.doc: For on_perceive: the room the event happened in.

fields.name: target
fields.doc: The target actor, or the target item of use and item skills.

fields.name: targets
fields.doc: Opponents for on_combat_tick, summoned mobs for on_summon, or the actors a cast landed on, for on_skill_use.

fields.name: text
fields.doc: Spoken text, for on_say and on_tell.

fields.name: to_room
fields.doc: The room the actor is going to, for exit hooks.

fields.name: type
fields.doc: The damage type, for on_damage.

fields.name: via_exit
fields.doc: For on_perceive: this mob's own exit toward the event, or None for its own room.

fields.name: weapon
fields.doc: The weapon used in an attack, or None for unarmed.

methods.name: act
methods.doc: Queues a command line for a mob, exactly as if it typed it.

params.name: mob
params.doc: The mob that acts.

params.name: command_line
params.doc: The command line, as a player would type it.

methods.name: act_advance
methods.doc: Queues one step along the room track toward target for a mob.

params.name: mob
params.doc: The mob that acts.

params.name: target
params.doc: Actor or item in the same room to step toward.

methods.name: act_attack
methods.doc: Queues an attack against target for a mob.

params.name: mob
params.doc: The mob that acts.

params.name: target
params.doc: Actor to attack.

methods.name: act_cast
methods.doc: Queues casting a skill for a mob.

params.name: mob
params.doc: The mob that acts.

params.name: skill
params.doc: Skill label to cast.

params.name: target
params.doc: Target actor or item, or None for the skill's default target.

methods.name: act_move
methods.doc: Queues a move through an exit for a mob.

params.name: mob
params.doc: The mob that acts.

params.name: dir
params.doc: Direction of the exit to take.

methods.name: act_retreat
methods.doc: Queues one step along the room track away from target (or toward the room back) for a mob.

params.name: mob
params.doc: The mob that acts.

params.name: target
params.doc: Actor or item to step away from, or None to step toward the back of the room.

methods.name: add_tag
methods.doc: Adds a tag to an item's effective tags; True if it was not already present.

params.name: item
params.doc: Item to tag.

params.name: tag
params.doc: Tag to add.

methods.name: adjust_standing
methods.doc: Adjusts standing directly for holder and subject by amount.

params.name: holder
params.doc: Mob view or faction label holding the opinion.

params.name: subject
params.doc: Actor view or faction label the opinion is about.

params.name: amount
params.doc: Integer amount to adjust.

methods.name: after
methods.doc: Calls fn(ctx, **args) on this hook's owner after some pulses. fn must be a top-level function; args must be storable.

params.name: pulses
params.doc: Pulses to wait, at least 1.

params.name: fn
params.doc: Top-level function fn(ctx, **args) to call.

params.name: args
params.doc: Keyword arguments passed to fn; values must be storable (int, str, bool, list or dict).

methods.name: allies_near
methods.doc: Actors of the same side (players with players, mobs with mobs) within a band who are not fighting actor, and members of actor's group (and their pets) within the band, simulated and not fighting actor.

params.name: actor
params.doc: The actor whose allies are wanted.

params.name: band
params.doc: Maximum distance: 'melee', 'near' or 'far'.

methods.name: apply_affect
methods.doc: Attaches a buff or debuff to an actor, an item or a room; re-applying a name replaces it.

params.name: target
params.doc: Actor, item or room to receive the affect.

params.name: name
params.doc: Affect name; applying the same name again replaces the existing affect.

params.name: duration
params.doc: Duration in pulses; None makes an item affect permanent.

params.name: stat_deltas
params.doc: Stat adjustments while the affect lasts, built with stats(...).

params.name: flags
params.doc: Flags the affect grants, such as 'no_regen'.

params.name: tick_every
params.doc: Pulses between on_tick calls, or None for no ticking.

params.name: on_tick
params.doc: Top-level function fn(ctx) called every tick_every pulses.

params.name: on_expire
params.doc: Top-level function fn(ctx) called when the affect expires or is removed.

params.name: expire_msg
params.doc: Text sent to the target when the affect ends.

params.name: modifiers
params.doc: Rules modifiers active while the affect lasts, by modifier point name.

params.name: sense_deltas
params.doc: Sense score changes by channel while the affect lasts.

params.name: max_vital_deltas
params.doc: Vital maximum adjustments while the affect lasts, built with vitals(...).

params.name: resist_deltas
params.doc: Damage resistance adjustments while the affect lasts, built with resists(...).

params.name: applies
params.doc: Item affects only: 'worn' or 'carried'.

params.name: procs
params.doc: Combat procs that fire during auto-attack swings.

params.name: add_tags
params.doc: Tags a room gains while the affect lasts; a room affect only.

params.name: remove_tags
params.doc: Tags a room loses while the affect lasts; a room affect only.

methods.name: award_xp
methods.doc: Awards experience points to actor, applying pending levels in auto mode or sending the ready notice in deferred mode. Returns None. Needs the leveling feature.

params.name: actor
params.doc: Actor to receive experience.

params.name: amount
params.doc: Points to award; must be at least 1.

methods.name: call_hook
methods.doc: Runs entity's custom hook name as fn(ctx, **args) with ctx.self the entity, then the plugin handlers for name, and returns their result as a fresh copy.

params.name: entity
params.doc: Actor, item or room whose hook runs.

params.name: name
params.doc: Custom hook name.

params.name: args
params.doc: Keyword arguments for the hook: int, str, bool, list, dict or actor, item and room views.

methods.name: cancel
methods.doc: Cancels one of this owner's timers; True if it was pending.

params.name: timer_id
params.doc: Timer id returned by ctx.after.

methods.name: clear_active
methods.doc: Removes a set_active reason from an entity.

params.name: entity
params.doc: Actor, item or room.

params.name: reason
params.doc: The reason given to set_active.

methods.name: clear_anchor
methods.doc: Removes a set_anchor reason from an entity.

params.name: entity
params.doc: Actor, item or room.

params.name: reason
params.doc: The reason given to set_anchor.

methods.name: clear_contributions
methods.doc: Empties victim's contribution record, or removes one contributor's entry.

params.name: victim
params.doc: Actor whose record is cleared.

params.name: contributor
params.doc: Contributor to remove, or None for the whole record.

methods.name: clear_owner
methods.doc: Removes a mob's owner. Returns whether it had one.

params.name: mob
params.doc: The mob to release.

methods.name: clear_standing
methods.doc: Clears standing records for holder, optionally restricted to subject.

params.name: holder
params.doc: Mob view or faction label holding the opinion.

params.name: subject
params.doc: Actor view or faction label, or None to clear all records for holder.

methods.name: close_container
methods.doc: Closes an open container; a locked one stays locked.

params.name: item
params.doc: Container item to close.

methods.name: close_door
methods.doc: Closes an open door in direction dir.

params.name: room
params.doc: Room, or room label, that has the exit.

params.name: dir
params.doc: Direction of the exit.

methods.name: damage
methods.doc: Deals damage directly to one vital (no to-hit roll, no mitigation); fires on_damage with just that loss.

params.name: target
params.doc: Actor to damage.

params.name: amount
params.doc: Points of damage.

params.name: type
params.doc: A declared damage type, such as DAMAGE.fire.

params.name: vital
params.doc: The declared vital that loses the points.

params.name: source
params.doc: Actor credited with the damage; an omitted or None source is the applier of the affect whose hook is running.

methods.name: del_attr
methods.doc: Deletes an attribute key from an entity.

params.name: entity
params.doc: Actor, item or room.

params.name: key
params.doc: Attribute key; unprefixed keys are in your package's namespace.

methods.name: deny
methods.doc: Vetoes the action; return it from a before_* hook.

params.name: msg
params.doc: Text shown to the actor whose action is refused.

methods.name: destroy
methods.doc: Removes an item and everything inside it, or count of a stack.

params.name: item
params.doc: Item to remove from the world.

params.name: count
params.doc: Number of items of the stack to remove, or None for the whole stack.

methods.name: disposition
methods.doc: What holder thinks of subject, -100 to 100: the default sum of its parts or the world's disposition export, then plugins.

params.name: holder
params.doc: The actor holding the opinion.

params.name: subject
params.doc: The actor the opinion is about.

methods.name: echo
methods.doc: Sends text to everyone in a room, except the actors in exclude.

params.name: room
params.doc: Room, or room label, to send the text to.

params.name: text
params.doc: Text to send.

params.name: exclude
params.doc: Actors who don't receive the text.

methods.name: emit
methods.doc: Raises a perceivable event on a channel. It spreads through nearby rooms from room, weakening on the way; actors who can perceive it hear or see it through on_perceive and rules.perceive_message.

params.name: channel
params.doc: A built-in or declared channel name.

params.name: event
params.doc: Event name that on_perceive hooks see.

params.name: intensity
params.doc: Strength at the origin; 0 or less emits nothing.

params.name: text
params.doc: Text that goes with the event.

params.name: room
params.doc: Room, or room label, where it happens; defaults to ctx.room.

params.name: actor
params.doc: Actor who caused it; defaults to ctx.actor. The causer does not perceive it.

methods.name: emote
methods.doc: The room sees '<actor> text'.

params.name: actor
params.doc: Actor performing the emote.

params.name: text
params.doc: Text that follows the actor's name.

methods.name: enemies_near
methods.doc: Opponents of actor within a band ('melee', 'near', 'far').

params.name: actor
params.doc: The actor whose opponents are wanted.

params.name: band
params.doc: Maximum distance: 'melee', 'near' or 'far'.

methods.name: factions_of
methods.doc: The faction labels actor belongs to, as a list of strings.

params.name: actor
params.doc: The actor.

methods.name: find
methods.doc: Entities of a prototype, ascending id. scope is 'room' (the owner's room), 'zone' (its package) or 'world'.

params.name: label
params.doc: Prototype label to look for.

params.name: scope
params.doc: Where to look: 'room', 'zone' or 'world'.

methods.name: get_attr
methods.doc: Reads a value; your own keys by short name, other packages' by 'namespace:key'.

params.name: entity
params.doc: Actor, item or room.

params.name: key
params.doc: Attribute key; your own by short name, another package's as 'namespace:key'.

params.name: default
params.doc: Value returned when the key is absent.

methods.name: give
methods.doc: Puts an item (a view, or a label to spawn) into an actor's inventory.

params.name: actor
params.doc: Actor who receives the item.

params.name: label_or_item
params.doc: Item view to move, or item prototype label to spawn.

params.name: count
params.doc: Number of items to spawn or move; defaults to 1 for a label, or the whole stack for an item.

methods.name: gmcp
methods.doc: Sends a GMCP event to a player's client. Returns whether it was sent.

params.name: player
params.doc: Actor who receives the event; mobs receive nothing.

params.name: package
params.doc: A GMCP package this package declared, or one nested in it.

params.name: data
params.doc: None, int, str, bool, list or dict (16 KB of JSON at most).

methods.name: group_add
methods.doc: Adds a player to another player's group, creating one if the other has none.

params.name: member
params.doc: Player to add.

params.name: to
params.doc: Player whose group the member joins.

methods.name: group_disband
methods.doc: Dissolves a player's whole group at once.

params.name: member
params.doc: Player whose group is dissolved.

methods.name: group_members
methods.doc: The members of an actor's group, leader first; [] when it has none.

params.name: actor
params.doc: Actor whose group members are wanted.

methods.name: group_of
methods.doc: The group an actor is in, or None; a pet resolves through its owner.

params.name: actor
params.doc: Actor whose group is wanted.

methods.name: group_remove
methods.doc: Removes a player from its group; a group left with one member is disbanded.

params.name: member
params.doc: Player to remove.

methods.name: group_set_leader
methods.doc: Makes a member the leader of its group.

params.name: member
params.doc: Player to make the leader.

methods.name: has_feature
methods.doc: Whether the world has the named feature: an engine feature that is on, or one a loaded plugin provides.

params.name: name
params.doc: Feature id, such as 'combat'.

methods.name: heal
methods.doc: Restores a vital of target, up to its maximum.

params.name: target
params.doc: Actor to heal.

params.name: amount
params.doc: Points to restore.

params.name: vital
params.doc: The declared vital to restore.

params.name: source
params.doc: Actor credited with the healing; an omitted or None source is the applier of the affect whose hook is running.

methods.name: here
methods.doc: The actor or ground item in the owner's room matching a keyword, or None.

params.name: keyword
params.doc: Keyword to match, as a player would type it.

methods.name: level_down
methods.doc: Lowers actor by up to count levels, stopping at level 1. Returns the number of levels actually lost. Needs the leveling feature.

params.name: actor
params.doc: Actor to lower.

params.name: count
params.doc: Number of level steps to unwind; must be at least 1.

methods.name: level_up
methods.doc: Applies one pending level to actor, in either level mode. In deferred mode, sends the ready notice again if more levels are still pending. Returns True if a level was gained, or False, changing nothing, if none was pending. Needs the leveling feature.

params.name: actor
params.doc: Actor to advance.

methods.name: lock_container
methods.doc: Closes and locks the container. Only a container whose prototype names a key has a lock.

params.name: item
params.doc: Container item to lock.

methods.name: lock_door
methods.doc: Closes and locks the door.

params.name: room
params.doc: Room, or room label, that has the exit.

params.name: dir
params.doc: Direction of the exit.

methods.name: merge_stack
methods.doc: Merges an item into an identical stack in the same place; returns the stack that holds it.

params.name: item
params.doc: Item to merge.

methods.name: move_item
methods.doc: Moves an item, or count of a stack, to a room (at index), an actor's inventory, or a container. Returns the moved item.

params.name: item
params.doc: Item to move.

params.name: to
params.doc: Room or room label, actor, or container item.

params.name: index
params.doc: Track index when moving to a room.

params.name: count
params.doc: Number of items of the stack to move, or None for the whole stack.

methods.name: move_toward
methods.doc: Queues one step toward a direction, an actor (advancing within the room) or a room. False if there is no way.

params.name: mob
params.doc: The mob that acts.

params.name: dir_or_target
params.doc: Direction, actor, or room (view or label) to head for.

methods.name: open_container
methods.doc: Opens the container, even if locked.

params.name: item
params.doc: Container item to open.

methods.name: open_door
methods.doc: Opens the door in direction dir, even if locked.

params.name: room
params.doc: Room, or room label, that has the exit.

params.name: dir
params.doc: Direction of the exit.

methods.name: path_to
methods.doc: Directions from the owner's room to a room or actor through open exits; [] if already there, None if unreachable.

params.name: target
params.doc: Room, room label, or actor to reach.

methods.name: plan
methods.doc: Goal-oriented planning: the cheapest list of action names that reaches goal from facts, [] if it already holds, None if unreachable or out of bounds.

params.name: facts
params.doc: Dict of fact name to bool, int or str.

params.name: actions
params.doc: List of dicts with name, pre, effects and cost.

params.name: goal
params.doc: Dict of fact name to the value it must have.

params.name: max_expansions
params.doc: Search nodes to expand at most, 1 to 16384.

methods.name: remove_affect
methods.doc: Removes an affect by name; True if there was one.

params.name: target
params.doc: Actor, item or room carrying the affect.

params.name: name
params.doc: Affect name.

methods.name: remove_skill
methods.doc: Forgets the skill, a label or skill view, and returns whether the actor knew it.

params.name: actor
params.doc: Actor who forgets the skill.

params.name: skill
params.doc: Skill label, or the skill's view.

methods.name: remove_tag
methods.doc: Removes a tag from an item's effective tags; True if it was present.

params.name: item
params.doc: Item to untag.

params.name: tag
params.doc: Tag to remove.

methods.name: report_skill_use
methods.doc: Reports a use of a skill to the global on_skill_use hook, with outcome 'report'. Needs the skills feature.

params.name: actor
params.doc: Actor who used the skill.

params.name: skill
params.doc: Skill label, or the skill's view.

params.name: target
params.doc: Target actor, or None.

params.name: item
params.doc: Item involved, or None.

methods.name: roll
methods.doc: Rolls dice such as '2d6+1'.

params.name: dice
params.doc: Dice expression such as '2d6+1'.

methods.name: say
methods.doc: speaker says text aloud; fires on_say.

params.name: speaker
params.doc: Actor who speaks.

params.name: text
params.doc: Text spoken.

methods.name: send
methods.doc: Sends text to one actor.

params.name: target
params.doc: Actor who receives the text.

params.name: text
params.doc: Text to send.

methods.name: set_active
methods.doc: Keeps an entity simulated (its queue, timers, AI and movement) even outside the bubble, until its last reason is cleared.

params.name: entity
params.doc: Actor, item or room.

params.name: reason
params.doc: Name for this reason; clear_active with the same name removes it.

methods.name: set_anchor
methods.doc: Makes an entity project a bubble of its own, as players do, until its last reason is cleared.

params.name: entity
params.doc: Actor, item or room.

params.name: reason
params.doc: Name for this reason; clear_anchor with the same name removes it.

methods.name: set_attr
methods.doc: Stores a value (int, str, bool, list or dict) on an entity. None deletes the key.

params.name: entity
params.doc: Actor, item or room.

params.name: key
params.doc: Attribute key; unprefixed keys are in your package's namespace.

params.name: value
params.doc: Value to store (int, str, bool, list or dict), or None to delete the key.

methods.name: set_charges
methods.doc: Sets an item's remaining uses, from 0 to its prototype's charges.

params.name: item
params.doc: Item with charges.

params.name: charges
params.doc: Uses left; 0 doesn't run the empty action.

methods.name: set_owner
methods.doc: Makes a player the owner of a mob, replacing any owner it had. The mob then runs its owned behaviors, leaves its spawn rule and stops fighting its owner's side. Returns whether anything changed.

params.name: mob
params.doc: The mob that becomes a pet.

params.name: player
params.doc: The in-world player that owns it.

methods.name: set_skill
methods.doc: Gives actor the skill, a label or skill view, at proficiency (0 to 100), or changes the proficiency it has. Runs the learn restrictions and returns the refusal message, or None once the skill is set. Needs the skills feature.

params.name: actor
params.doc: Actor who learns or raises the skill.

params.name: skill
params.doc: Skill label, or the skill's view.

params.name: proficiency
params.doc: Proficiency, 0 to 100.

methods.name: skill_info
methods.doc: The skill a label names, as ctx.skill in a cast, or None when no loaded skill has it.

params.name: label
params.doc: Skill label, or the skill's view.

methods.name: spawn
methods.doc: Spawns a mob (in a room) or an item (in a room, on an actor, or in a container). Returns its view, or a list when count > 1 makes several.

params.name: label
params.doc: Mob or item prototype label.

params.name: at
params.doc: Room or room label, actor, or container item.

params.name: index
params.doc: Track index when spawning into a room.

params.name: count
params.doc: Number to spawn; more than 1 returns a list.

methods.name: standing
methods.doc: The amount of holder's standing record about subject, 0 when there is none; declared faction opinions are not records.

params.name: holder
params.doc: Mob view or faction label holding the record.

params.name: subject
params.doc: Actor view or faction label the record is about.

methods.name: standing_event
methods.doc: Raises a custom standing event on affected by actor.

params.name: affected
params.doc: The actor affected.

params.name: actor
params.doc: The actor who acted.

params.name: event
params.doc: The event name.

params.name: amount
params.doc: Optional positive amount.

params.name: item
params.doc: Optional item view.

methods.name: standing_history
methods.doc: Queries standing history for holder and subject since a pulse.

params.name: holder
params.doc: Mob view or faction label holding the opinion.

params.name: subject
params.doc: Actor view or faction label the opinion is about.

params.name: since
params.doc: Start pulse for the query.

params.name: via
params.doc: Optional mob view filtering the event source.

params.name: event
params.doc: Optional event name filter.

methods.name: start_combat
methods.doc: Engages two actors in the same room in combat.

params.name: a
params.doc: First actor.

params.name: b
params.doc: Second actor, in the same room.

methods.name: stop_combat
methods.doc: Ends combat between a and b, or all of a's fights when b is None.

params.name: a
params.doc: Actor whose fighting stops.

params.name: b
params.doc: Opponent, or None for all of a's fights.

methods.name: summon
methods.doc: Spawns count mobs of prototype label beside caster as its summons. Returns the mobs as a list.

params.name: caster
params.doc: Actor the mobs are summoned beside.

params.name: label
params.doc: Mob prototype label.

params.name: count
params.doc: Number of mobs to summon; at least 1.

params.name: duration
params.doc: Pulses until the summoned affect expires and the mob fades away, or None.

methods.name: take_xp
methods.doc: Removes up to amount experience points from actor, never going below 0. Never changes level and sends no message. Returns the amount actually removed. Needs the leveling feature.

params.name: actor
params.doc: Actor to remove experience from.

params.name: amount
params.doc: Points to remove; must be at least 1.

methods.name: teleport
methods.doc: Moves an actor to a room; fires the exit and enter hooks.

params.name: actor
params.doc: Actor to move.

params.name: room
params.doc: Destination room or room label.

params.name: index
params.doc: Track index on arrival, or None for the room's default.

methods.name: transform
methods.doc: Swaps an item's prototype in place, keeping instance attributes, affects and tags.

params.name: item
params.doc: Item to transform.

params.name: label
params.doc: Target item prototype label.

methods.name: unlock_container
methods.doc: Unlocks the container, leaving it closed.

params.name: item
params.doc: Container item to unlock.

methods.name: unlock_door
methods.doc: Unlocks the door, leaving it closed.

params.name: room
params.doc: Room, or room label, that has the exit.

params.name: dir
params.doc: Direction of the exit.

views.name: exit
views.doc: A read-only view of an exit.

fields.name: direction
fields.doc: The exit's direction name.

fields.name: door
fields.doc: The exit's door, or None without one.

fields.name: entry_index
fields.doc: Destination track index where travellers arrive, or -1 for the back.

fields.name: key
fields.doc: The door's key label, or None.

fields.name: one_way
fields.doc: True if this exit intentionally has no return exit.

fields.name: passable
fields.doc: False while a door is closed or locked.

fields.name: tags
fields.doc: Tags declared on exit(tags = [...]), sorted.

fields.name: to
fields.doc: The destination room's label.

effects.name: heal
effects.doc: Restore a vital, up to its maximum.

params.name: dice
params.doc: Amount restored, as dice such as '2d4'.

params.name: vital
params.doc: The declared vital to restore.

behaviors.name: wander
behaviors.doc: Behavior: with a percent chance per think, steps through a random open exit within radius exits of home.

params.name: radius
params.doc: Maximum distance from home, in exits.

params.name: chance
params.doc: Percent chance of taking a step on each think, 0 to 100.

params.name: priority
params.doc: Proposal priority; higher wins. None uses the behavior's default.

ctx.name: rules_ctx
ctx.doc: The read-only context of a rules call or modifier.

fields.name: action
fields.doc: For door_intensity: 'open', 'close', 'lock' or 'unlock'.

fields.name: actor
fields.doc: Whom the call is about: the attacker, caster, mover or regenerating actor.

fields.name: affect
fields.doc: In a modifier contributed by an actor affect or an item instance affect, that affect's view; None everywhere else.

fields.name: amount
fields.doc: In standing_change, the healing done or the count given; otherwise None.

fields.name: attacker
fields.doc: For attack calls, the same as actor.

fields.name: band
fields.doc: 'melee', 'near' or 'far' between actor and target, or None.

fields.name: behaviors
fields.doc: The mob's prototype behaviors, as behavior values, in owned_behaviors; None elsewhere.

fields.name: carried
fields.doc: The weight carried and worn, containers' contents included; None outside encumbrance_level and encumbrance.

fields.name: channel
fields.doc: For the perception calls: the channel name, such as 'sound'.

fields.name: contributors
fields.doc: The victim's contributors, as contributor structs, in xp_share; None elsewhere.

fields.name: cost
fields.doc: For can_perceive and perceive_message: the attenuation summed along the cheapest path from the event's room; 0 in that room.

fields.name: damage_type
fields.doc: The damage type as a string in auto-attack to_hit and damage calls, damage chains and mitigate, otherwise None.

fields.name: defender
fields.doc: For attack calls, the one attacked; also the one taking damage in mitigate.

fields.name: disposition_parts
fields.doc: In rules.disposition, a struct with declared, faction_to_actor, faction_to_faction, personal and total; None elsewhere.

fields.name: encumbrance_level
fields.doc: The level encumbrance_level just gave; None outside encumbrance.

fields.name: event
fields.doc: For can_perceive and perceive_message: the event name, such as 'say' or 'combat'.

fields.name: exit
fields.doc: For sense_cost: the exit of ctx.room leading back toward the signal's source. For door_intensity: the door's exit, or None for a container.

fields.name: helped
fields.doc: In an assist standing event, the actor helped; None elsewhere.

fields.name: intensity
fields.doc: For can_perceive and perceive_message: the event's strength where it happened.

fields.name: item
fields.doc: The item, for get_lag and carry_limit.

fields.name: limit
fields.doc: The actor's carry limit asked without an item; None outside encumbrance_level and encumbrance.

fields.name: pet
fields.doc: In a standing event raised for a pet's owner, the pet; None elsewhere.

fields.name: pulse
fields.doc: Game time; not available in xp_to_level.

fields.name: rng
fields.doc: The seeded random number generator; not available in xp_to_level.

fields.name: room
fields.doc: The actor's room; for sense_cost, the room the signal enters.

fields.name: skill
fields.doc: The skill being cast or evaluated, or None.

fields.name: slot
fields.doc: The slot of the swinging item in an auto-attack swing, 'wield' for an unarmed swing, otherwise None.

fields.name: source
fields.doc: For can_perceive and perceive_message: the actor who caused the event, or None.

fields.name: source_room
fields.doc: For can_perceive and perceive_message: the room the event happened in.

fields.name: tags
fields.doc: For door_intensity: the door's or container's tags, sorted.

fields.name: target
fields.doc: The other actor of the call, if any: the defender, the pinner, the victim, the killer, or the actor advanced on or retreated from.

fields.name: text
fields.doc: For can_perceive and perceive_message: the event's text, or None.

fields.name: via_exit
fields.doc: For can_perceive and perceive_message: the listener's exit leading toward the event, or None in the event's own room.

fields.name: weapon
fields.doc: The weapon used in an attack, or None for unarmed.

fields.name: xp
fields.doc: The experience pool a kill is being settled for, in xp_share; None elsewhere.

methods.name: deny
methods.doc: Refuses a cast; valid only in cast_allowed and its modifiers.

params.name: msg
params.doc: Text shown to the caster.

methods.name: factions_of
methods.doc: The faction labels actor belongs to, as a list of strings.

params.name: actor
params.doc: The actor.

methods.name: roll
methods.doc: Rolls dice such as '2d6+1' with the seeded rng; not available in xp_to_level.

params.name: dice
params.doc: Dice expression such as '2d6+1'.

methods.name: standing
methods.doc: The amount of holder's standing record about subject, 0 when there is none; declared faction opinions are not records.

params.name: holder
params.doc: Mob view or faction label holding the record.

params.name: subject
params.doc: Actor view or faction label the record is about.

methods.name: standing_history
methods.doc: Queries standing history for holder and subject since a pulse.

params.name: holder
params.doc: Mob view or faction label holding the opinion.

params.name: subject
params.doc: Actor view or faction label the opinion is about.

params.name: since
params.doc: Start pulse for the query.

params.name: via
params.doc: Optional mob view filtering the event source.

params.name: event
params.doc: Optional event name filter.

exports.name: actor_slots
exports.doc: The slots ctx.actor has, a subset of equipment_slots().

modifier_points.name: advance_lag
modifier_points.doc: Adjusts the recovery lag in pulses after advance. ctx.target is the actor approached; ctx.band is the band after the step. The final result is clamped to 0.

harness.name: t
harness.doc: The test context: makes worlds and checks results.

methods.name: contains
methods.doc: Fails unless a string contains a substring, or a list or dict contains an item.

params.name: container
params.doc: String, list or dict to search.

params.name: item
params.doc: Substring, element or key to find.

params.name: msg
params.doc: Extra text for the failure message.

methods.name: eq
methods.doc: Fails unless actual == expected. An entity view equals its label, so t.eq(p.room, ':hall') works.

params.name: actual
params.doc: Value under test.

params.name: expected
params.doc: Expected value.

params.name: msg
params.doc: Extra text for the failure message.

methods.name: fail
methods.doc: Fails the test.

params.name: msg
params.doc: Failure message.

methods.name: false
methods.doc: Fails unless the value is falsy.

params.name: value
params.doc: Value under test.

params.name: msg
params.doc: Extra text for the failure message.

methods.name: ne
methods.doc: Fails if actual == unexpected.

params.name: actual
params.doc: Value under test.

params.name: unexpected
params.doc: Value it must not equal.

params.name: msg
params.doc: Extra text for the failure message.

methods.name: not_contains
methods.doc: Fails if a string contains a substring, or a list or dict contains an item.

params.name: container
params.doc: String, list or dict to search.

params.name: item
params.doc: Substring, element or key that must be absent.

params.name: msg
params.doc: Extra text for the failure message.

methods.name: true
methods.doc: Fails unless the value is truthy.

params.name: value
params.doc: Value under test.

params.name: msg
params.doc: Extra text for the failure message.

methods.name: world
methods.doc: A fresh headless world with the given packages (default: this test's package) and the rules package. The `load` argument is spelled `packages`, since load is a Starlark keyword. rules names another rules package to use instead of //rules. bubble=True keeps a reality bubble, so only rooms near players are simulated; by default every room is.

params.name: seed
params.doc: Random seed for the world.

params.name: packages
params.doc: Packages to load, or None for this test's package.

params.name: rules
params.doc: Rules package label such as //rules_alt, or None for //rules.

params.name: bubble
params.doc: True to simulate only rooms near players; by default every room is simulated.
